# Agenda 0.10.2
- Finishing a task that has two or more sub-tasks now gets a small celebration at its checkbox, scaled to how many sub-tasks it had, plus a note of the count. - Days on which you finished such tasks get tiny marks above their dot in the progress bar (more marks for bigger tasks), and hovering the day lists them first. - Nothing about how tasks are counted has changed.

# Agenda 0.10.1
- Delivers the optional effort points setting (Settings → Effort points) to anyone who installed an early copy of 0.10.0 that was missing it. Your points stay on, and switching them off never deletes points you've set.
Everything else in this release is described in the 0.10.0 notes: https://github.com/willschulz/agenda-releases/releases/tag/v0.10.0

# Agenda 0.10.0
Agenda is now open source under the GPL: https://github.com/willschulz/agenda
- Edit your board's rows: Settings → Edit Rows lets you rename, add, reorder, and delete rows. Deleting a row asks which row its projects should move to. - New boards open a short welcome tour and start with Correspondence, Life Stuff, and Work Miscellany in Top of Mind. - Effort points are now optional (Settings → Effort points). With them off, every task counts as 1 and point badges are hidden. Your board keeps points on after this update, and switching them off never deletes points you've set. - Usage-limit dials show how fast you're using your Claude and Cursor subscription limits, for whichever tools you use. - AI usage now shows each project's share by tool. You can also record what you pay for each tool and see that cost split across projects. - Search finds todos by task number (#123 or 123). - Clicking a todo's hover number copies its #id and short title. - Hovering the right side of the gap between two todos inserts a subtask under the todo above. - Removes the agent-pickup and lookup copy buttons from todo cards. - Before an update changes your database's structure, Agenda now saves a backup of it first. This update does that once, when it converts your rows to the new editable format.
